guidance: docs/SUPERVISOR_FEEDBACK_2026-11-11.md and the supervisor's reply of 2026-11-11 (PDH first, then methanation, then NH3/MeOH blind tests; validation TEA held out; tolerances and the disagreement rule fixed in advance).
change_from_pdh: build mode V2 (user decision 2026-11-12): the agent draws the process first (flowsheet.json with an 8-category checklist, submit_flowsheet) and may write model.py only afterwards; model energy and capital are sums over the flowsheet units; check_model adds a physics-consistency gate (element and mass balance, per-pass conversion <= equilibrium + 0.03 with NIST Shomate thermo, reaction heat, heat supply, isothermal minimum compression work, minimum separation work, unit-sum accounting). The three PDH builds keep their V1 results.
task: runner.py --build ch4 --reaction 'CO2 methanation (CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O)'

agent.workspace: D:/agent_runs/<run> (outside the repository); scripts restricted to relative paths

not_visible_to_the_agent: agent/new_reactions/plant_models.py, plant_framework.py, configs/*, params*.json, SOURCES.md, results/*
the NCE repository and its PRs (url fragments audited)
builds: 3 independent builds ch4_b1..b3 (separate workspaces); a build that fails check_model at finish or whose holdout audit finds a leak is invalid and replaced; every replacement is reported
diagnostic: one PDH build with V2 (pdh_v2_d1) to see whether flowsheet-first closes the PDH energy gap; reported as a diagnostic, it does not replace or join the three V1 PDH builds
validation: evaluate_builds.py against holdout/ch4.json (H2 and CO2 t/t +-5 %, purchased primary energy GJ/t +-35 %, capital per annual t -30/+50 % on the D5.9 scale curve at the build's capacity); pass/partial/fail as in pass_rule

agreement_rule.per_conclusion: largest cost item, controlling catalyst property, cheapest catalyst on the common record set (the 255 PR #122 CH4 records): robust = 3/3, majority = 2/3, model-dependent = no majority; all three builds reported
agreement_rule.quantitative: reference-cost spread max/min - 1 <= 20 % and every pairwise Spearman of record costs >= 0.8 is called consistent
agreement_rule.primary_build: the build with the median reference cost, fixed before the holdout comparison is looked at
agreement_rule.selection: no selection of builds by TEA fit

ledger: stage_ledger.csv per build; human_log.csv (every human intervention with type and minutes)
